description: Returns the countries, currencies and payment rails a person living in from_country can send money to with Morse when paying someone else's bank account, with the typical delivery time for each. Use it to answer whether Morse can send from one country to another. An empty destinations list means sending to other people's bank accounts is not offered from that country. When the result includes get_started_url, show it to the user as the way to continue in the Morse app.

from_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the sender lives in, e.g. US. If the user has not said where they live, ask them before quoting; do not assume.

name: list_send_destinations
